blocks.text: Exception handling program chalte waqt aane wali ghaltiyon (errors) ko sambhalne ke liye hai. Yeh program ko crash hone (achanak band hone) se rokti hai aur ghair-mutawaqqa halaat mein saleeqe se jawab dene deti hai. Theek exception handling program par bharosa aur user ka tajurba behtar karti hai. Python exceptions pakarne aur sambhalne ke built-in tools deta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Exception handling programs ko achanak ruke baghair ghair-mutawaqqa masle sambhalne deti hai.

import sqlite3

try:
    # Connect to database
    connection = sqlite3.connect("school.db")
    cursor = connection.cursor()

    # Insert data into table
    cursor.execute("INSERT INTO students (ID, Name, Age) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (1, "Ali", 20))

    # Save changes (ensures data integrity)
    connection.commit()
    print("Data inserted successfully")

except sqlite3.Error as e:
    # Handle database errors
    print("Error occurred:", e)
    connection.rollback()  # Undo changes if error occurs

finally:
    # Close connection
    if connection:
        connection.close()
        print("Connection closed")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"try:": is block mein woh code hai jis mein ghalti ho sakti hai: database se jorna, cursor banana aur data dalna (INSERT).
"VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (1, "Ali", 20)": teen ? placeholders (khaali jagahen) hain; qeematein 1, "Ali" aur 20 alag tuple mein di gayi hain aur sqlite3 inhein khud sahi jagah rakhta hai.
"connection.commit()" aur "print("Data inserted successfully")": sab theek ho to data save hota hai aur yeh paigham aata hai.
"except sqlite3.Error as e:": database ki koi bhi ghalti yahan pakri jati hai; e mein ghalti ka paigham hota hai. "connection.rollback()" adhoori tabdeeli wapas (undo) karta hai.
"finally:": ghalti ho ya na ho, yeh hissa hamesha chalta hai: connection band kar ke "Connection closed" print karta hai.
Output (khaali folder mein, jahan school.db mein students table nahi): "Error occurred: no such table: students" phir "Connection closed". Agar chapter 4 ka connection program pehle chal chuka ho (Ali ko id 1 mil chuki), to "Error occurred: UNIQUE constraint failed: students.id" aur "Connection closed". Agar table ho magar ID 1 na ho, to "Data inserted successfully" aur "Connection closed". Teenon suraton mein program crash nahi hota.

items: try-except → ghaltiyan sambhalta aur crash rokta hai.
commit() → sahi data mehfooz karta hai (data ki durusti, integrity).
rollback() → ghalti ho to tabdeeliyan wapas (cancel) karta hai.
finally → har haal mein chalta hai aur database ko mehfooz tareeqe se band karta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Agar students table mein ID 1 na ho to output 'Data inserted successfully' aur 'Connection closed' hai. Agar ID 1 pehle se ho (maslan chapter 4 ka program chalane ke baad, jahan Ali ko id 1 mili), to sqlite3 error deta hai (UNIQUE constraint failed: students.id); except use pakar kar 'Error occurred: ...' dikhata hai, rollback() hota hai, aur finally phir bhi 'Connection closed' chhapta hai. Program crash nahi hota.

blocks.alt: try mein connection aur data insert. Koi error na ho to commit() data save karta hai aur 'Data inserted successfully' chhapta hai; sqlite3.Error aaye to except error dikhata hai aur rollback() tabdeeli wapas leta hai. Dono raste finally tak jate hain jo connection band kar ke 'Connection closed' chhapta hai.
blocks.caption: try, except aur finally ke raste (hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Agar connection hi nakam ho
blocks.text: Agar sqlite3.connect() khud nakam ho to connection ka naam banta hi nahi, is liye finally mein 'if connection:' NameError deta hai, aur except wala rollback bhi isi tarah nakam hota hai. try se pehle connection = None likhna, aur rollback se pehle bhi 'if connection:', ise theek karta hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Aisa Python program likhein jo user se do numbers le, aur exception handling se ghalti ka paigham dikhaye agar user ghalat input de ya zero se taqseem (divide) karne ki koshish kare.

items: try mein khatre wala code; except ghalti sambhalta; finally hamesha chalta hai.
commit() achhi tabdeeli save; rollback() ghalti par wapas.
